name: wpmcp/get-page
description: Read a page

name: wpmcp/update-blocks
description: Update a page's block content

name: wpmcp/list-operations
description: List recent safety snapshot operations

name: wpmcp/rollback-operation
description: Undo a single operation by restoring its pre-change snapshot

name: wpmcp/rollback-session
description: Undo all operations from a session by restoring each object's pre-session snapshot

name: wpmcp/list-post-types
description: List registered post types (posts, pages, custom post types)

name: wpmcp/list-taxonomies
description: List registered taxonomies (categories, tags, custom taxonomies)

name: wpmcp/create-post
description: Create a post, page, or custom post type

name: wpmcp/get-post
description: Read a single post, page, or custom post type

name: wpmcp/get-preview-link
description: Preview URL for a draft, pending or scheduled post you can edit

name: wpmcp/update-post
description: Partially update a post, page, or custom post type

name: wpmcp/delete-post
description: Delete a post, page or CPT entry. Trash by default. force:true deletes permanently, is off until the wpmcp_enable_delete_post filter opts in, needs confirm:true. Both undoable

name: wpmcp/list-posts
description: List/search posts, pages, or custom post types

name: wpmcp/duplicate-post
description: Copy a post, page or CPT entry (content, meta but _edit_lock and _wp_old_slug, terms, builder data; children optional) as a draft unless status is set. stage:true: one linked draft to edit; publish_stage:<stage id> writes it over the original (same ID, URL, comments; refused if the original changed, unless force; undo: rollback-operation); discard_stage deletes it

name: wpmcp/diff-revisions
description: Diff two revisions of a post, or one revision against the post's current state: a unified diff per changed field (title, content, excerpt) rather than two full documents. Unchanged fields are omitted

name: wpmcp/count-content
description: Counts so a job can be sized before it starts: posts per public type by status, media by MIME family, comments by status, terms per taxonomy, users per role. From core counting APIs, so figures match wp-admin

name: wpmcp/set-post-terms
description: Assign taxonomy terms to a post (replace, append, or remove)

name: wpmcp/list-revisions
description: List a post's revisions (id, author, date, change excerpt)

name: wpmcp/get-revision
description: Read a single post revision's fields

name: wpmcp/restore-revision
description: Restore a post to a given revision

name: wpmcp/get-media
description: Read a Media Library attachment: title, URL, every registered size and missing_sizes, dimensions, mime type, alt text, caption and description

name: wpmcp/update-media
description: Update an attachment's title, alt text, caption or description

name: wpmcp/delete-media
description: Delete a Media Library attachment. Off until the wpmcp_enable_delete_media filter opts in; needs confirm:true. force:true deletes permanently, snapshotted (undoable)

name: wpmcp/sideload-image
description: Add an image to the Media Library from a url, or from a prompt via the site's AI provider (ratio e.g. 16:9). Undo: rollback-operation

name: wpmcp/upload-media
description: Upload a file to the Media Library from base64 data, an https url, or grant:true (returns a one-use upload URL and curl, for large files). Type sniffed from the bytes, not mime_type; executables and SVG refused; capped at the upload limit. Undo: rollback-operation

name: wpmcp/list-media
description: List Media Library attachments, filtered by type ("image" or a mime like "image/png"), after/before dates and search, paged newest first with total/pages. missing_sizes:true adds each image's ungenerated registered sizes

name: wpmcp/find-unused-media
description: Attachments nothing references (featured image, site logo/icon, content, builder data, post/term meta, options) with size on disk and checks run. Pass next_cursor as cursor until done; unattached:true lists parent-0 ones apart

name: wpmcp/resize-media
description: Regenerate the given registered image sizes of an attachment from its original and report each file (name, dimensions, URL). Omit sizes to fill the missing ones; media_ids: up to 20 attachments. Snapshot-first with a file backup (undoable)

name: wpmcp/upload-svg
description: Add an SVG to the Media Library from markup or an allowlisted URL. A fail-closed sanitizer rejects script, foreignObject, event handlers and external references; only sanitized markup is stored. Rollback deletes it

name: wpmcp/set-stock-key
description: Store (or clear with an empty api_key) your own pexels or unsplash API key. Keys are encrypted at rest with a site-salt-derived key and never echoed back

name: wpmcp/search-stock-images
description: Search openly-licensed stock images: openverse (keyless, Creative Commons), pexels and unsplash (own key via set-stock-key). Results carry license, license_url, attribution and source_url for import-stock-image

name: wpmcp/import-stock-image
description: Sideload a stock search result into the Media Library. SSRF-guarded: https only, host allowlist (wpmcp_remote_media_allowed_hosts filter) checked first, no redirects, size caps, bytes must verify as an image. Stores attribution and license. Undo: rollback-operation

name: wpmcp/get-settings
description: Read WordPress site settings (general, reading, writing, discussion, media, permalinks), each with its group, type and whether it is writable

name: wpmcp/update-settings
description: Update WordPress site settings from a strict allowlist. Validates/coerces each value (enum, int range, bool), rejects unsafe permalink structures, skips read-only or non-allowlisted keys and still applies the valid subset

name: wpmcp/list-users
description: List WordPress users as safe summary rows (id, username, display name, email, roles, registration date). Display name and email are masked (masked: true): use get-user for full values. Never returns password hashes or other secrets

name: wpmcp/get-user
description: Read one user's profile detail, including an is_admin flag derived from live capabilities. Never returns the password hash

name: wpmcp/create-user
description: Create a new non-admin user. Auto-generates a strong password (never returned) and emails the new user so they can set their own. Rejects admin and unknown roles; defaults to subscriber. Undoable while it has no content and is unchanged

name: wpmcp/update-user
description: Update a non-admin user's profile fields (display name, email, url, nickname, first/last name, description). Refuses admin-capable users. Never changes role or password. Snapshotted so the change can be rolled back

name: wpmcp/list-comments
description: List comments by post and status (emails, IPs masked). view:akismet gives Akismet status and spam/pending counts

name: wpmcp/get-comment
description: Read one comment

name: wpmcp/moderate-comment
description: Set a comment's status: approve, unapprove, spam, not_spam (Akismet learns), trash, untrash, or recheck (Akismet rechecks pending; confirm:true). ids[] for up to 100. Reversible

name: wpmcp/edit-comment
description: Edit a comment's content or author name, email, url. Reversible

name: wpmcp/delete-comment
description: Permanently delete a comment, or empty_spam:true for up to 100 spam. Off until the wpmcp_enable_delete_comment filter opts in; needs confirm:true. Rollback restores under a new ID

name: wpmcp/create-comment
description: Comment on a post as you. status: approved (moderate_comments) or unapproved. Reversible

name: wpmcp/reply-to-comment
description: Reply to comment id; as create-comment

name: wpmcp/list-plugins
description: List installed plugins with active status, protected-package flag and pending update info; updates:true lists core, plugin and theme updates with auto-update state

name: wpmcp/activate-plugin
description: Activate an installed plugin. Undoable

name: wpmcp/deactivate-plugin
description: Deactivate a plugin. Refuses protected packages (wpmcp, Elementor). Undoable

name: wpmcp/install-plugin
description: Install a plugin from wordpress.org by slug. activate:true needs activate_plugins and is undoable

name: wpmcp/update-plugin
description: Update an installed plugin to the latest wordpress.org version. Disabled by default (wpmcp_enable_update_plugin filter) and needs confirm:true. File changes are not rollback-able

name: wpmcp/delete-plugin
description: Permanently delete an installed plugin's files. Disabled by default (wpmcp_enable_delete_plugin filter) and needs confirm:true. Refuses protected or active plugins. Not rollback-able

name: wpmcp/list-themes
description: List installed themes with active status, parent theme and pending update info

name: wpmcp/switch-theme
description: Activate an installed theme. Snapshots the prior template/stylesheet options (undoable)

name: wpmcp/install-theme
description: Install a theme from wordpress.org by slug. activate: true also needs switch_themes and returns rollbackable operation_ids

name: wpmcp/update-theme
description: Update an installed theme to the latest wordpress.org version. Disabled by default (wpmcp_enable_update_theme filter) and needs confirm:true. File changes are not rollback-able

name: wpmcp/delete-theme
description: Permanently delete an installed theme's files. Disabled by default (wpmcp_enable_delete_theme filter) and needs confirm:true. Refuses the active theme (or its active parent). Not rollback-able

name: wpmcp/manage-updates
description: Update WordPress core or set plugin/theme auto-updates. type=core applies the offered core update (or pending DB upgrade); needs confirm:true and a full backup (trigger-backup type=full) under 1h old; refuses if expected_version differs from the offer. A core update cannot be snapshot-rolled-back; restore that backup to revert. type=plugin|theme + item + enabled sets auto-update (undoable). type=plugins|themes: action=plan lists pending updates; run (opt-in wpmcp_enable_safe_updates, confirm:true) snapshots each, updates, checks the site and auto-restores a broken one; status (run_id); restore (run_id, items)

name: wpmcp/search-plugins
description: Search the wordpress.org plugin directory by keyword, with optional tag/author filters and a capped per_page

name: wpmcp/get-plugin-info
description: Fetch full wordpress.org plugin directory info for a slug: version, rating, installs, homepage, download link and compatibility

name: wpmcp/search-themes
description: Search wordpress.org themes; filters as in search-plugins

name: wpmcp/list-tables
description: List database tables with estimated row counts and sizes

name: wpmcp/describe-table
description: Return the columns, types and keys of a database table

name: wpmcp/query
description: Run a read-only SQL query (SELECT/SHOW/DESCRIBE/EXPLAIN/WITH). Writes, DDL, stacked statements and file-access SQL are rejected before running. Reads of users/usermeta tables are blocked (wpmcp_db_allow_user_table_reads filter opts in, with secrets masked). Results are capped

name: wpmcp/insert-row
description: Insert a row into a table via $wpdb->insert() (parameterized). Refuses protected tables. Disabled by default (wpmcp_enable_db_writes filter)

name: wpmcp/update-rows
description: Update rows matching a mandatory equality WHERE via $wpdb->update(). Needs confirm:true and the wpmcp_enable_db_writes filter; refuses protected tables. Undo: rollback-operation if the table has a primary key and the WHERE fits the before-image cap, else recoverable:false with the before-image in the write audit log

name: wpmcp/delete-rows
description: Delete rows matching a mandatory equality WHERE. Needs confirm:true and the wpmcp_enable_db_writes filter; refuses protected tables. Undo: rollback-operation (rows reinserted with their ids) if the table has a primary key and the WHERE fits the before-image cap, else recoverable:false with the before-image in the write audit log

name: wpmcp/read-file
description: Read a file inside the WordPress install (core, plugins, themes, uploads); the path cannot leave it

name: wpmcp/list-directory
description: List entries (files/dirs with size and mtime) of a directory inside the WordPress install. Optional bounded recursive listing

name: wpmcp/search-files
description: Search file contents for a substring across a directory tree inside the WordPress install. Filterable by extension; results are capped

name: wpmcp/write-file
description: Create or overwrite a file in the WordPress install. Undo: rollback-operation. Refuses wp-config.php/.htaccess. Off by default (wpmcp_enable_fs_writes filter); needs edit_files, honors DISALLOW_FILE_EDIT. PHP must parse; a fatal on the front end or admin after saving reverts it; if that check cannot run, refused unless unchecked:true. encoding:base64 writes binary (5 MB, no PHP or scripts)

name: wpmcp/edit-file
description: Replace an exact string in a file (must match once unless replace_all). Undo: rollback-operation. Refuses wp-config.php/.htaccess. Off by default (wpmcp_enable_fs_writes filter); needs edit_files, honors DISALLOW_FILE_EDIT. PHP is checked and reverted as in write-file

name: wpmcp/delete-file
description: Delete a file in the WordPress install. Needs confirm:true. Undo: rollback-operation. Refuses wp-config.php/.htaccess. Off by default (wpmcp_enable_fs_writes filter); needs edit_files, honors DISALLOW_FILE_EDIT

name: wpmcp/analyze-performance
description: Scan server config, WordPress internals (database size, autoloaded options, cron backlog, object cache, OPcache, plugin count) and a page (frontpage, url or post_id) for performance bottlenecks. Returns a scored report with ranked fixes

name: wpmcp/scan-security
description: Scan this site for malware (deep=true: whole tree), core file integrity, hardening gaps, outdated software and known vulnerabilities (vulnerabilities=true; sends slugs and versions to wpvulnerability.net); checks:[compromise] looks for hack traces. Returns a 0-100 score, A-F grade and ranked fixes

name: wpmcp/incident-response
description: list-app-passwords (no secrets); revoke-app-password (uuid or all); list-sessions (one user, masked, no tokens); end-sessions (user_id or all); rotate-salts (wp-config.php, backup kept; refused if unwritable or defined elsewhere); reinstall-core-files (files scan-security flags, from the checksum-verified official package, never wp-content; undo: rollback-operation); quarantine-file (path, reason: moves it to a private folder; not core, wp-config or WPMCP files; undo: rollback-operation); list-quarantine; restore-quarantined-file (id, overwrite); purge-quarantined-file (id). Quarantine needs the wpmcp_enable_fs_writes opt-in. Writes need confirm:true. Cannot be undone: revoke, end-sessions, rotate-salts (logs out everyone, your cookie session too, not app passwords). Your session and app password stay unless include_current. Other users take edit_users

name: wpmcp/get-cache-status
description: Report active caching layers: the object cache backend (external or internal), OPcache and any page-cache plugin (WP Rocket, W3 Total Cache, WP Super Cache, LiteSpeed Cache, WP Fastest Cache) detected by its functions or constants

name: wpmcp/clear-cache
description: Flush caches: object cache, all transients, OPcache when enabled and any detected page-cache plugin through its own API. Returns what each layer cleared or lacked. Idempotent; not snapshotted (a cache has no before-image)

name: wpmcp/build-page
description: Compose a page from ONE declarative spec: title, a recursive sections/blocks tree, media (existing attachment ids), optional menu placement. One atomic, recoverable operation: the spec is strictly validated (node-path errors, bounded size/nodes/depth) before any write, a mid-build failure removes everything it created, and success returns one operation_id whose rollback-operation removes the page and its menu placement. Markup is composed deterministically; nothing in the spec is evaluated or executed. The spec composes block editor (Gutenberg) markup. dry_run=true validates and composes WITHOUT writing, reporting element counts per node type, nesting depth, markup size and every referential problem at once

items.description: One node of the recursive sections tree. Gutenberg dialect types: group, columns, column, buttons (containers, may have children); heading{text,level}, paragraph{text}, list{items,ordered}, quote{text,citation}, image{attachment_id|url,alt}, button{text,url}, separator, spacer{height}, code{text}, html{html}, pattern{slug, top-level only} (leaves).

name: wpmcp/list-products
description: List WooCommerce products as safe summary rows (id, name, sku, price, stock status), filterable by search, status, type, or category, with paging

name: wpmcp/get-product
description: Read full detail for one WooCommerce product (prices, stock, description, categories, tags)

name: wpmcp/create-product
description: Create a simple WooCommerce product via the CRUD layer. rollback-operation on the returned operation_id trashes it

name: wpmcp/update-product
description: Update a WooCommerce product's fields (price, stock, description, etc.). stock_status is accepted only while stock is unmanaged and never on a variable product. Snapshotted as a post; rollback-operation restores the prior price and stock exactly

name: wpmcp/delete-product
description: Delete a WooCommerce product (trash by default, force for permanent). Off until the wpmcp_enable_delete_product filter opts in; needs confirm:true. Snapshotted: rollback resurrects a force-deleted product at its id with price, stock and terms

name: wpmcp/list-product-categories
description: List WooCommerce product categories (the product_cat taxonomy) as summary rows (id, name, slug, parent, count)

name: wpmcp/list-orders
description: List WooCommerce orders as safe summary rows (id, number, status, total, currency, date), filterable by status and customer, with paging. HPOS- and CPT-safe

name: wpmcp/get-order
description: Read full detail for one WooCommerce order (status, billing email, payment method, line items, customer note). HPOS- and CPT-safe

name: wpmcp/update-order-status
description: Change a WooCommerce order's status, validated against the store's registered statuses. Snapshotted via the wc_order object type so rollback-operation restores the prior status exactly. HPOS- and CPT-safe

name: wpmcp/add-order-note
description: Add an internal or customer-facing note to a WooCommerce order. Additive only; nothing to roll back

name: wpmcp/get-sales-report
description: Read-only sales summary over a date range: order count, gross sales, items sold and top products by quantity. Aggregated over wc_get_orders() (HPOS- and CPT-safe)

name: wpmcp/list-variations
description: List the variations of one variable WooCommerce product as safe summary rows (id, sku, attributes, prices, stock), with paging

name: wpmcp/update-variation
description: Update a WooCommerce variation: regular_price, sale_price, sku, status (publish/private), manage_stock, stock_quantity and stock_status (only while stock is unmanaged). Snapshotted; rollback-operation restores price and stock, keeps it attached to its parent and re-syncs the parent's price range

name: wpmcp/list-low-stock-products
description: List products and variations at or below a managed-stock threshold (default: the store's low-stock setting) or out of stock, as rows whose ids feed update-product/update-variation. Page while has_more is true

name: wpmcp/create-variation
description: Add a variation to a variable product. attributes maps each variation attribute to one of its options ("" or omitted = any); unknown attributes or options are refused. Prices, sku, status and stock follow update-variation's rules. rollback-operation trashes it

name: wpmcp/delete-variation
description: Permanently delete a product variation (there is no variation trash). Disabled until the site opts in via the wpmcp_enable_delete_variation filter; needs confirm:true. Snapshotted: rollback-operation resurrects it at the same id, attached to its parent

name: wpmcp/bulk-update-products
description: Update up to 50 products and variations in one call; each item {id, ...fields} as update-product/update-variation take them, same rules and permission checks. Per item: ok, operation_id or error; one failure does not stop the rest. rollback-session on the returned session_id undoes the batch

name: wpmcp/list-coupons
description: List coupons as summary rows (id, code, status, type, amount, usage, expiry), with code search, status filter and paging

name: wpmcp/get-coupon
description: Read one coupon's full settings by id or code (limits, restrictions, usage)

name: wpmcp/create-coupon
description: Create a coupon. Refuses a code already in use, an unknown discount_type, a percent over 100 or an invalid email restriction. Status defaults to draft. rollback-operation trashes it

name: wpmcp/update-coupon
description: Update a coupon's fields with the same checks as create-coupon. Snapshotted: rollback-operation restores every setting and usage history

name: wpmcp/delete-coupon
description: Delete a coupon (trash by default, force for permanent). Disabled until the site opts in via the wpmcp_enable_delete_coupon filter; needs confirm:true. Snapshotted: rollback-operation restores it at the same id

name: wpmcp/validate-coupon
description: Check whether a coupon code would be accepted: published, expiry, usage limits, and (when email or subtotal is given) per-customer limit, email allow-list and spend rules. Each rule reports pass, fail or skipped; cart-dependent rules are flagged

name: wpmcp/list-tax-rates
description: List the store's tax classes and tax rates, filterable by class or country, with paging. Read-only

name: wpmcp/create-tax-rate
description: Create a tax rate. rate is a percentage from 0 to 100; country must be a known ISO code or "" for all; class must be standard or an existing class. rollback-operation deletes it while unchanged

name: wpmcp/update-tax-rate
description: Update a tax rate with the same checks as create-tax-rate; postcodes and cities replace the whole list. Snapshotted: rollback-operation restores the row and its locations

name: wpmcp/delete-tax-rate
description: Delete a tax rate. Disabled until the site opts in via the wpmcp_enable_delete_tax_rate filter; needs confirm:true. Snapshotted: rollback-operation restores it at the same id

name: wpmcp/plan-product-import
description: Plan a product import; writes nothing. Rows: sku, name, type (simple/variable), regular_price, sale_price, stock, categories, attributes, variations, images (media ids or https URLs), status. Per row: create, update (diff), skip or error; plus a plan_hash

name: wpmcp/apply-product-import
description: Apply a plan-product-import plan: same rows and mode plus its plan_hash. Refused if the store or rows changed; confirm:true above the threshold. rollback-session on its session_id undoes it

name: wpmcp/list-menus
description: List the site's navigation menus as safe summary rows (id, name, slug, item count)

name: wpmcp/get-menu
description: Read one navigation menu with its ordered items (id, title, url, type, parent, order)

name: wpmcp/list-menu-locations
description: List the theme's registered menu locations and the menu (if any) assigned to each

name: wpmcp/create-menu
description: Create a navigation menu (a nav_menu term). Undoable while unchanged, empty and in no location

name: wpmcp/add-menu-item
description: Add an item to a navigation menu (custom link by title and url, or an object link via type, object, object_id). Undoable

name: wpmcp/update-menu-item
description: Update a navigation menu item's title, url, parent, or position. Snapshotted as a post; rollback-operation restores the prior values exactly

name: wpmcp/remove-menu-item
description: Remove an item from a navigation menu. Snapshotted as a post; rollback-operation resurrects it at its original id, re-attached to its menu

name: wpmcp/assign-menu-to-location
description: Assign a navigation menu to a registered theme location (the nav_menu_locations theme_mod). Snapshotted; rollback-operation restores the prior assignment

name: wpmcp/delete-menu
description: Delete a navigation menu (a nav_menu term). Off until the wpmcp_enable_delete_menu filter opts in; needs confirm:true. Not automatically reversible: the menu name and items are returned for a manual rebuild

name: wpmcp/list-widgets
description: List Elementor registered widget types (name, title, categories, icon, tier, availability), annotated from the curated catalog (purpose, cataloged flag). Filter by tier (free/pro), category or case-insensitive search (name, title, catalog keywords)

name: wpmcp/get-widget-schema
description: The settings schema for one Elementor widget type: curated typed params (defaults, enums, responsive hints, required plugin) for cataloged widgets, or with full:true (and for non-cataloged widgets) the full introspected control stack

name: wpmcp/get-global-settings
description: Read the Elementor kit's global colors, typography, spacing and layout. Returns the settings_hash the global color and typography writes require

name: wpmcp/regenerate-elementor-css
description: Rebuild Elementor CSS; all needs confirm

name: wpmcp/list-field-groups
description: List registered ACF (Advanced Custom Fields) field groups: key, title, flattened location rules and whether each is active

name: wpmcp/get-fields
description: Read a post's ACF field values, keyed by field name, via get_fields()

name: wpmcp/update-fields
description: Set one or more ACF field values on a post via update_field(). Snapshotted as a post; rollback-operation restores the prior values exactly. Disabled by default (site must opt in via the wpmcp_enable_acf_write filter)

name: wpmcp/get-seo-status
description: Which SEO plugin is active, by name and version

name: wpmcp/get-crawler-files
description: robots.txt (served output, physical file, managed rules), llms.txt, and the served sitemap (core or SEO plugin) with its post types

name: wpmcp/update-crawler-files
description: Add robots.txt rules per User-agent, build llms.txt, or exclude post types, taxonomies or posts from the core sitemap (lists replace). Refused if a file or SEO plugin owns it. Snapshotted

name: wpmcp/get-seo-meta
description: Read a post's SEO title, meta description, focus keyword, canonical URL, and robots flags (noindex/nofollow) via the active SEO plugin's postmeta keys

name: wpmcp/update-seo-meta
description: Set a post's SEO title, meta description, focus keyword, canonical URL and/or robots flags (noindex/nofollow) via the active SEO plugin's postmeta keys. Snapshotted as a post; rollback-operation restores the prior values exactly

name: wpmcp/list-languages
description: List the site's languages (code, name, which is default) via the active multilingual plugin (Polylang or WPML)

name: wpmcp/get-post-translations
description: Read a post's translations (the translated post id and title, keyed by language code) via the active multilingual plugin (Polylang or WPML)

name: wpmcp/set-post-language
description: Assign a post to a language (by code) via the active multilingual plugin (Polylang or WPML). Snapshotted as a post (a Polylang language is a term); rollback-operation restores the prior language assignment exactly

name: wpmcp/link-post-translations
description: Link posts as translations of one another from {language, post_id} pairs via Polylang or WPML. Only the primary (first) post is snapshotted, so rollback restores that post, not the others

name: wpmcp/find-orphan-posts
description: List published posts or pages that have zero incoming internal links (orphans), by scanning the most-recent posts for links that resolve to this site's own content

name: wpmcp/suggest-internal-links
description: Suggest related published posts a given post should link to, ranked by shared categories/tags and title keyword overlap, excluding posts it already links to

name: wpmcp/get-link-map
description: Summarize the internal-link graph: per-post outgoing and incoming link counts, the orphan list and the most-linked posts

name: wpmcp/list-redirects
description: List this site's redirects (the active redirect plugin's, else WPMCP's own: source path, resolved target, status code, enabled, hit count), plus pending suggestions raised when a published post was deleted or moved. Filter by enabled state or a search string. Read-only

provider.description: wpmcp, redirection or rankmath; default: the one active redirect plugin, else wpmcp

name: wpmcp/create-redirect
description: Create a redirect (in the active redirect plugin, else WPMCP's own table) from a source path to a target URL or target_post_id (which survives slug changes). Chains are flattened to one hop and loops refused; the stored target is reported. Snapshotted; rollback-operation removes it

provider.description: wpmcp, redirection or rankmath; default: the one active redirect plugin, else wpmcp

name: wpmcp/update-redirect
description: Change one redirect: its source, target/target_post_id, status code, enabled state or notes. Only the fields you pass change. Retargeting re-runs chain flattening and loop detection. Snapshotted and reversible

provider.description: wpmcp, redirection or rankmath; default: the one active redirect plugin, else wpmcp

name: wpmcp/delete-redirect
description: Delete one redirect. The whole row is snapshotted first, so rollback-operation brings the same redirect back; use update-redirect with enabled:false instead to stop it firing while keeping its hit history

provider.description: wpmcp, redirection or rankmath; default: the one active redirect plugin, else wpmcp

name: wpmcp/find-broken-links
description: Scan published content for internal links that are dead, point at a non-public post or go through a redirect. background:true queues a batched scan; poll it with scan_id. Proposes fixes, changes no content

name: wpmcp/get-post-meta
description: Read a post's meta, either the full map or a single key. Protected meta (a leading underscore, or is_protected_meta) is always skipped

name: wpmcp/set-post-meta
description: Set a single meta key/value on a post. Refuses protected meta keys (a leading underscore, or is_protected_meta). Snapshotted via object_type post; rollback-operation restores the prior value

name: wpmcp/get-option
description: Read one wp_options value by name. Refuses sensitive/core option names (auth keys, salts, siteurl, home, active_plugins and secret/password/token-shaped names)

name: wpmcp/update-option
description: Update one wp_options value. Refuses get-option's denylist; off unless filter wpmcp_enable_option_write is on. Keeps an array/object option's type unless allow_type_change. Undoable

name: wpmcp/get-debug-config
description: Debug constants (WP_DEBUG, WP_DEBUG_LOG, WP_DEBUG_DISPLAY, SCRIPT_DEBUG, SAVEQUERIES) and, when logging is on, the debug.log path. No secrets

name: wpmcp/get-debug-log
description: Bounded tail (max 200 lines / 64KB) of the debug log, by default WP_CONTENT_DIR/debug.log or the WP_DEBUG_LOG path. A path argument is confined to WP_CONTENT_DIR. source:access searches the access log, newest first (opt-in, IPs masked): filter {ip,path,status,method,agent,since,until,around_file,window minutes}, lines max 200, cursor; summary:true: top IPs, paths, wp-content PHP POSTs

name: wpmcp/list-transients
description: List transients (name, expiry) with an optional search substring; limit default 50, max 500

name: wpmcp/delete-transient
description: Delete one named transient (cache data, not snapshotted) or run cleanup: expired_transients, revisions (beyond keep newest per post, default 5), auto_drafts (7+ days old), trash (older than days, default 0), spam_comments, orphaned_meta. Dry run by default (counts, bytes, sample ids); dry_run:false+confirm applies up to 200 items/10s, returning a cursor to resume. rollback-operation undoes all but transients; attachments and parents are skipped

name: wpmcp/get-site-health
description: Run Site Health tests, plugin-added ones included, as plain text. Async tests past timeout seconds (default 10, max 30) report not completed. cached: last full run. mail_test: how mail is sent (no secrets); your or admin email + confirm sends a test (manage_options, rate limited)

name: wpmcp/list-cron-events
description: List the scheduled WP-Cron events (hook, next-run timestamp, recurrence/schedule, interval in seconds, callback args) from the cron array, plus the available schedules from wp_get_schedules(). Optional hook filter

name: wpmcp/schedule-event
description: Schedule a recurring (recurrence checked against wp_get_schedules()) or single event. Refuses core-critical hooks (wp_version_check, wp_update_plugins/themes, wp_scheduled_delete, delete_expired_transients, wp_privacy_delete_old_export_files). Snapshots the cron option; rollback-operation restores it

name: wpmcp/unschedule-event
description: Unschedule one occurrence (wp_unschedule_event, given timestamp and matching args) or every event for a hook (wp_clear_scheduled_hook). Core hooks included, made safe by snapshotting the cron option: rollback-operation restores it

name: wpmcp/run-event
description: Fire a scheduled cron hook now via do_action(), for debugging. Off until the wpmcp_enable_run_cron_event filter opts in; fires only hooks present in the cron array, always with their stored args. Not snapshotted: firing a hook is irreversible

name: wpmcp/get-maintenance-status
description: Whether the site is gated: WPMCP maintenance mode (message, Retry-After), core .maintenance, coming soon and maintenance plugins

name: wpmcp/enable-maintenance
description: Turn maintenance mode on (wpmcp_maintenance option: enabled, message, retry_after seconds). Logged-out visitors and users without manage_options get a 503 with the message until disabled. Snapshotted; rollback-operation restores the prior state

name: wpmcp/disable-maintenance
description: Turn maintenance mode off: sets enabled=false on the wpmcp_maintenance option (message and retry_after are preserved for a later re-enable). Snapshotted; rollback-operation restores the prior state

name: wpmcp/get-site-context
description: Orientation payload: site name, URL, tagline, WordPress and PHP versions, theme, active plugins, public post types with counts, taxonomies, user count, locale, timezone, multisite and active integrations. No admin email

name: wpmcp/get-page-snapshot
description: One-call page digest from stored post_content: structure counts, outline, media and link inventory, builder detection, SEO-lite signals (content_coverage flags builder page gaps). Heavy sections (global_tokens, responsive_overrides) opt-in via sections. Size-capped

name: wpmcp/get-rendered-html
description: Visitor-view HTML of a site page (post_id or url/path), chunked

name: wpmcp/list-rest-routes
description: List routes on this site's REST server (core and plugin namespaces): path, methods and a short args summary. Optional namespace and search filter by substring; limit caps rows (default 50, max 200). Read-only: never executes a route

name: wpmcp/call-rest
description: Run an internal REST request on any local route; returns status and body. The route's permission_callback runs as the current user, so access cannot widen. GET/HEAD always run; writes need the wpmcp_enable_rest_writes filter (default off) and confirm:true, and are not snapshotted (recoverable:false)

name: wpmcp/list-block-types
description: List registered block types: name, title, category, is_dynamic and attribute names. Optional category (exact) and search (substring on name) filters

name: wpmcp/get-block-type
description: Return full detail for a single registered block type by name: its attributes schema, declared supports and block-context wiring (uses_context, provides_context)

name: wpmcp/parse-blocks
description: Parse block markup into its block tree via parse_blocks(). Takes "blocks" (raw markup) or "id" (parses that post's post_content). Each node reports blockName, attrs, recursively parsed innerBlocks, and an innerHTML summary

name: wpmcp/serialize-blocks
description: Serialize a block tree (parse-blocks shape) back into block markup via serialize_blocks(). A pure transform that never touches a post; write the result with update-blocks

name: wpmcp/convert-html-to-blocks
description: Convert raw HTML to Gutenberg block markup: h1-h6, p, img, ul/ol, blockquote, pre/code, hr and table map to core blocks; anything else is wrapped in core/html so nothing is lost. Pure transform, never touches a post; write it with update-blocks

name: wpmcp/add-block
description: Insert ONE block ("<!-- wp:... -->" markup) into a post at path (zero-based indexes into the parse-blocks tree; the last may equal the sibling count to append). Needs expected_hash (content_hash from parse-blocks); stale reads refused. Snapshot-first; other blocks stay byte-identical

name: wpmcp/update-block
description: Update ONE block by path (zero-based indexes into the parse-blocks tree, through innerBlocks): replace attrs (whole) and/or inner_html (leaf blocks only; a container's children by their own paths). Needs expected_hash (content_hash from parse-blocks); stale reads refused. Snapshot-first; other blocks stay byte-identical

name: wpmcp/remove-block
description: Remove ONE block by path (zero-based indexes into the parse-blocks tree, descending innerBlocks); nested removals keep the container. Needs expected_hash (content_hash from parse-blocks); stale reads refused. Snapshot-first; undo: rollback-operation

name: wpmcp/move-block
description: Move the block at from_path to position to_index among its own siblings (same parent only; compose remove-block + add-block to move across parents). Needs expected_hash (content_hash from parse-blocks); stale reads refused. Snapshot-first

name: wpmcp/duplicate-block
description: Duplicate the block at path (deep copy, inserted immediately after the original within the same parent) and return the copy's new_path. Needs expected_hash (content_hash from parse-blocks); stale reads refused. Snapshot-first

name: wpmcp/list-patterns
description: List registered block patterns: name, title, description, categories. Optional search (substring on name or title). Markup is not returned; insert-pattern inserts it server-side

name: wpmcp/insert-pattern
description: Insert a registered block pattern's blocks into a post at path (add-block's path semantics; whitespace filler dropped). Needs expected_hash (content_hash from parse-blocks); stale reads refused. Snapshot-first; existing blocks stay byte-identical

name: wpmcp/site-templates-read
description: List the block theme's templates and parts (source theme/custom, area, customized) or wp_navigation menus; entity plus id reads one as parsed blocks and content_hash. global_styles: theme/user/merged theme.json, variations, fonts (id: dot path narrows). Reports a classic theme

name: wpmcp/site-templates-write
description: Edit a block theme template or part (id: slug or theme//slug) or wp_navigation menu (id). save: content or blocks, customizing over the theme file; add_block (content: one block)/update_block/remove_block: by path with expected_hash; revert: delete the customization. global_styles (no id): save attrs {dot.path: value|null} to user styles, preset entries by slug; variation: title; revert: reset. Snapshot-first

name: wpmcp/list-shortcodes
description: List registered shortcode tags ($shortcode_tags): tag name and a short description of its callback where resolvable. Optional search (substring of the tag name) narrows the result

name: wpmcp/render-shortcode
description: Render a shortcode string (e.g. "[gallery ids=\"1,2\"]") via do_shortcode() and return the HTML. Only invokes registered shortcode tags; input without an opening "[" is refused

name: wpmcp/list-sidebars
description: List the sidebars/widget areas registered via register_sidebar(): id, name, description

name: wpmcp/list-sidebar-widgets
description: List the widgets assigned to a single sidebar (by sidebar_id): widget id and display name, from wp_get_sidebars_widgets() resolved against the registered widgets

name: wpmcp/create-sidebar-widget
description: Add a classic widget (registered id_base, incl. block) to a sidebar at a 0-based position, sanitized by its update(). Undoable

name: wpmcp/update-sidebar-widget
description: Merge settings into a classic widget (id like text-2) via its update(). Undoable

name: wpmcp/move-sidebar-widget
description: Move a classic widget to a sidebar or wp_inactive_widgets at a 0-based position. Undoable

name: wpmcp/delete-sidebar-widget
description: Delete a classic widget instance. Undoable

name: wpmcp/list-terms
description: List terms in a taxonomy with search, parent filter, ordering and pagination. Empty terms are INCLUDED unless hide_empty is set (the opposite of core's default), so a partial list never leads to creating a duplicate

name: wpmcp/get-term
description: Read one term by term_id or slug, with its meta and full ancestor chain. Ancestors disambiguate a hierarchical taxonomy, where several same-named terms sit under different parents

name: wpmcp/create-term
description: Create a category, tag or custom taxonomy term. Snapshot-first; rollback-operation reverses the creation. Refuses an existing slug, a missing parent, or a parent on a non-hierarchical taxonomy

name: wpmcp/update-term
description: Update a term's name, slug, description or parent, snapshot-first. Refuses a slug held by another term, and refuses reparenting onto itself or a descendant: core permits that and the resulting cycle makes the taxonomy unrenderable

name: wpmcp/delete-term
description: Delete a term, snapshot-first. Rolling back restores it at its original term_id and term_taxonomy_id and refiles the posts that were in it. Reports objects affected; refuses a taxonomy's default term

name: wpmcp/set-term-meta
description: Write or delete a term meta value, snapshot-first (whole term plus meta map captured, so rollback is exact). value:null deletes the key, staying distinct from an empty string. Protected keys are refused

name: wpmcp/export-content
description: WXR export via core export_wp(), narrowed by content, author, start_date, end_date, status, to a protected uploads dir; returns path, size, count. Once per PHP process (core limit). mirror:true instead writes builder pages as stable JSON for git (post_id, or all 50 per page)

name: wpmcp/list-exports
description: List the WXR export files previously generated by export-content: file name, size in bytes and created timestamp for each

name: wpmcp/import-content
description: Import a WXR from the exports dir as new posts (title, content, status, post_type, postmeta). Off by default (wpmcp_enable_import filter), needs confirm:true, not snapshotted (recoverable:false); returns created_post_ids for delete-post. mirror:true + post_id restores that page from its export-content mirror (undoable)

name: wpmcp/trigger-backup
description: Queue a WP-Cron backup job; returns its job id. type=full: portable site archive (zip: full SQL dump, wp-content, origin manifest) to restore or migrate; database/files/uploads narrow it; content: WXR export. every=daily [HH:MM], weekly [mon-sun] [HH:MM] (site time) or off schedules that type instead; each run prunes its archives past keep (default 7), never manual ones or after a failed run

name: wpmcp/get-backup-status
description: Return a backup job's current record (status: queued/running/completed/failed/canceled, result artifact reference or error, timestamps) by job id

name: wpmcp/list-backup-jobs
description: List backup jobs, newest first, optionally by status (queued/running/completed/failed/canceled), plus schedules (next run, overdue, last run)

name: wpmcp/cancel-backup-job
description: Cancel a queued or running backup job: unschedule its event, or stop the run at its next heartbeat. Errors if unknown, a running restore, or terminal

name: wpmcp/get-backup-manifest
description: Read a completed site-backup archive's manifest by job id or path: origin site_url/home_url, table prefix, multisite, WordPress/PHP/plugin versions, scope, per-table row counts, BLOB tables and file count. Read-only; paths outside the site-backup dir are refused

name: wpmcp/delete-backup-archive
description: Delete a site-backup archive by job id or path and report bytes freed. The job record stays, flagged deleted, so history never points at a missing file. Paths outside the site-backup directory are refused

name: wpmcp/restore-site-backup
description: Restore this site from a site-backup archive (job_id or site-backup path). dry_run (default true) reports format, scope, prefix, multisite, WP downgrade, BLOB tables and a full db.sql parse (truncated dumps refused). dry_run=false queues a restore job and returns its job_id at once (wait=true runs inline); poll get-backup-status. The job takes a database safety archive (none: no restore), holds maintenance, rolls back on failure. preserve_session (default true) keeps you signed in; include_files (default false, scope all) swaps in staged wp-content

name: wpmcp/rewrite-site-urls
description: Rewrite one site URL to another across the database (options, postmeta, posts, termmeta, usermeta, comments), serialization-aware for plain, JSON-escaped, percent-encoded and scheme-relative forms; object values are refused and reported. dry_run (default) reports per-table counts; dry_run:false + confirm:true takes a database safety archive first or refuses, returning its job_id for restore-site-backup. Skips wpmcp_db_protected_tables (usermeta by default); never rewrites GUIDs

name: wpmcp/push-site-archive
description: Push a site-backup archive (job_id or path; scope all or database) to another wpmcp site at target_url as its admin (target_user + target_app_password, or target_token). dry_run (default) only checks the target; dry_run:false + confirm:true uploads resumable chunks for max_seconds (call again to continue); apply:true has the target restore it (safety archive first) and rewrite URLs. Needs the outgoing-migration opt-in here, incoming there

name: wpmcp/receive-site-archive
description: Target side of push-site-archive. action start (sha256, bytes, manifest; checked before upload, resumes), chunk (upload_id, offset, base64 data), status, apply (verify, restore with a safety archive, rewrite URLs; dry_run default, confirm:true applies). Needs the incoming-migration opt-in

name: wpmcp/find-replace-content
description: Serialization-safe find and replace in post content, titles, excerpts or meta. dry_run (default) previews; apply returns a rollback-session id; over 10 posts needs confirm:true

name: wpmcp/build-change-set
description: Build a local-live sync change set (objects, media bytes, terms, templates, global classes, base revisions) from a ledger marker (session_id, operation_id or since_id) and/or object refs (post:ID, option:theme_mods_X, term:TAX:SLUG) as a JSON artifact in the site-backup dir. dry_run only lists it

name: wpmcp/get-change-set
description: Inspect a change-set artifact before it is applied: origin, objects, dependencies, exclusions, truncation. include_objects=true adds full data; raw=true returns the artifact to pass to apply-change-set on the target. Read-only; site-backup dir only

name: wpmcp/apply-change-set
description: Apply a change set (change_set from get-change-set raw=true, or path) here; dry_run defaults to true. Only selected objects are written, snapshot-first; media, terms and templates are only added; objects changed here since the base are refused unless keyed in force; deletions never apply. rollback-session undoes it

name: wpmcp/validate-php-snippet
description: Statically check a PHP snippet without running it: syntax validity (error message and line) and severity-tagged findings (eval, exec, shell_exec, backticks, obfuscation decoders, request-driven input, outbound HTTP)

name: wpmcp/create-php-snippet
description: Store a named PHP snippet, inactive (not Elementor custom code: see create-code-snippet). Never executed; syntax errors or critical static findings refuse it (advisory, not a security boundary). This build never executes or activates a stored snippet. Snapshot-first, reversible per snippet

name: wpmcp/list-php-snippets
description: List STORED PHP SNIPPETS as summaries (id, name, status, static-check flag, timestamps) without code. Not Elementor custom code (see list-code-snippets)

name: wpmcp/get-php-snippet
description: Fetch one STORED PHP SNIPPET by id: code, status and last static-check report (advisory, not proof of safety). Not Elementor custom code (see get-code-snippet)

name: wpmcp/update-php-snippet
description: Update a stored PHP snippet's name and/or code. New code is re-checked statically (advisory, not a security boundary) and never executed; a code change resets it to inactive. Snapshot-first, reversible per snippet

name: wpmcp/delete-php-snippet
description: Delete a stored PHP snippet by id (not an Elementor custom-code post: see delete-code-snippet). Snapshot-first, reversible per snippet (restored inactive); never executes anything

name: wpmcp/deactivate-php-snippet
description: Deactivate a stored PHP snippet by id: marks it inactive. This build cannot execute or activate a stored snippet, so this only clears a flag left by another install. Snapshot-first; never executes anything

name: wpmcp/export-bundle
description: Export PHP snippets, plus custom block/widget specs where present, as a checksummed JSON bundle for import-bundle; types and ids filter

name: wpmcp/import-bundle
description: Import an export-bundle: items are re-validated and created inactive; name clashes skip unless on_conflict=rename. Undo with rollback-session

name: wpmcp/get-connection-info
description: How to connect an MCP client here: the MCP endpoint URL, ready-to-paste snippets for Claude Code, Cursor, Claude Desktop and Antigravity with an Application Password placeholder, and the ChatGPT and Claude connector steps. Never returns a real credential. Read-only

name: wpmcp/list-tool-catalog
description: List abilities by domain: tier, operation, capability, read-only/destructive hints, counts. Filters: domain, tier, search (name, description or op name; op hits in matched_operations). Read-only

name: wpmcp/get-governance-settings
description: Return the stored governance toggle maps (ability, domain, operation) and site_wide mode: explicit enable/disable decisions layered on top of the wpmcp_{ability,domain,operation}_enabled filters

name: wpmcp/update-governance-settings
description: Batch-update stored governance toggles by ability, domain and operation, e.g. {ability: {"wpmcp/delete-post": false}, domain: {"database": false}}. Undoable; refuses unknown names and disabling the governance or undo tools. site_wide audits ability calls outside MCP; enforce also refuses abilities toggled off by name. auto_enable_new_tools: updates switch their new safe tools on

name: wpmcp/list-governance-audit-log
description: List governance-decision audit log entries (ability, active identity or "none", allowed/denied, timestamp, source: mcp/rest/server/cli/php), newest first. Optional limit (default 20) and source filter

name: wpmcp/create-identity
description: Create or overwrite (by name) a scoped identity that, once active (wpmcp_current_identity filter), narrows abilities beyond capability and Governance. Optional domains/operations/abilities allowlists, mode (allow default, or deny), exposure (full/compact, overrides site-wide mode), allowed_ips (IPs/CIDRs; other clients refused)

name: wpmcp/list-identities
description: List every registered scoped identity

name: wpmcp/delete-identity
description: Delete a scoped identity by name. Returns an error if no identity with that name exists

name: wpmcp/is-multisite
description: Whether this install is a multisite network. Always registered, even on single-site, so network status can be checked before the other multisite tools

name: wpmcp/get-analytics-connection-status
description: Whether an analytics provider (Google Site Kit or configured credentials) is active and appears connected. Always registered, so it can be checked before the other analytics tools

name: wpmcp/get-analytics-summary
description: Read-only sessions/users/pageviews summary over a date range (Y-m-d; default the 28 days ending yesterday) from the connected analytics provider, or the stats plugin named in source (default: first active). Errors when no provider is connected

name: wpmcp/get-top-pages
description: Read-only list of top pages by pageviews over a date range (Y-m-d; default the 28 days ending yesterday) from the connected analytics provider or the stats plugin named in source; limit default 10, max 100. Errors when no provider is connected

name: wpmcp/get-search-console-summary
description: Read-only clicks/impressions/ctr/position summary over a date range (Y-m-d; default the 28 days ending yesterday) from the connected Search Console provider. Errors when no provider is connected

name: wpmcp/get-search-console-queries
description: Read-only list of top search queries by clicks over a date range (Y-m-d; default the 28 days ending yesterday) from the connected Search Console provider; limit default 10, max 100. Errors when no provider is connected

name: wpmcp/list-tools
description: List tools: name, summary, domain, operation, tier. Filters: domain, search. full:true adds descriptions, annotations; include_unavailable:true, what cannot run and why. Schemas: get-tool-schema. Read-only

name: wpmcp/get-tool-schema
description: One tool's contract by name: input schema, description, annotations, domain/operation/tier, availability. Read-only; list-tools finds names

name: wpmcp/call-tool
description: Invoke any wpmcp tool by name with an arguments object (reaches tools compact mode hides). The target's own checks (capability, governance, identity scope, license, rate limit, input validation, snapshot/rollback) apply as if called directly, never widening access. Refuses non-wpmcp tools and the meta-tools

name: wpmcp/list-site-abilities
description: Abilities OTHER plugins register via the Abilities API: name, summary, owning plugin, whether an input schema exists and reversible:false (bridged results are outside wpmcp rollback). Optional plugin filter. Needs the ability bridge opt-in (default off)

name: wpmcp/get-site-ability
description: Read one third-party ability's full contract by name: description, input and output schemas, meta where provided, and owning plugin. Refuses wpmcp's own abilities (use get-tool-schema). Read-only; list-site-abilities finds names

name: wpmcp/execute-site-ability
description: Invoke one third-party ability by name with an arguments object. Its own permission callback always runs, plus wpmcp governance, identity scope and rate limiting. Results are reversible:false (bridged writes are outside wpmcp rollback). Refuses wpmcp's own abilities; needs the site bridge opt-in (default off)

name: wpmcp/acf-read
description: Read op on Advanced Custom Fields (field groups, post types, taxonomies, options and field values): operation + its args (list-operations lists each op's schema)

name: wpmcp/acf-write
description: Write op on Advanced Custom Fields (field groups, post types, taxonomies, options and field values): operation + args per its schema (list-operations on the read half). Snapshot-first if possible (undo: rollback-operation); destructive ops need confirm:true

name: wpmcp/contactform7-read
description: Read op on Contact Form 7 (forms, markup, mail templates, Flamingo entries): operation + its args (list-operations lists each op's schema)

name: wpmcp/contactform7-write
description: Write op on Contact Form 7 (forms, markup, mail templates, Flamingo entries): operation + args per its schema (list-operations on the read half). Snapshot-first if possible (undo: rollback-operation); destructive ops need confirm:true

name: wpmcp/gravitytables-read
description: Read op on Gravity Tables (data tables built from Gravity Forms entries): operation + its args (list-operations lists each op's schema)

name: wpmcp/gravitytables-write
description: Write op on Gravity Tables (data tables built from Gravity Forms entries): operation + args per its schema (list-operations on the read half). Snapshot-first if possible (undo: rollback-operation); destructive ops need confirm:true

name: wpmcp/mec-read
description: Read op on Modern Events Calendar (events and their schedules): operation + its args (list-operations lists each op's schema)

name: wpmcp/mec-write
description: Write op on Modern Events Calendar (events and their schedules): operation + args per its schema (list-operations on the read half). Snapshot-first if possible (undo: rollback-operation); destructive ops need confirm:true

name: wpmcp/tec-read
description: Read op on The Events Calendar (events and their schedules): operation + its args (list-operations lists each op's schema)

name: wpmcp/tec-write
description: Write op on The Events Calendar (events and their schedules): operation + args per its schema (list-operations on the read half). Snapshot-first if possible (undo: rollback-operation); destructive ops need confirm:true

name: wpmcp/give-read
description: Read op on GiveWP (donation forms, donations, donors, campaigns): operation + its args (list-operations lists each op's schema)

name: wpmcp/give-write
description: Write op on GiveWP (donation forms, donations, donors, campaigns): operation + args per its schema (list-operations on the read half). Snapshot-first if possible (undo: rollback-operation); destructive ops need confirm:true

name: wpmcp/pmpro-read
description: Read op on Paid Memberships Pro (membership levels, pricing, and member counts): operation + its args (list-operations lists each op's schema)

name: wpmcp/pmpro-write
description: Write op on Paid Memberships Pro (membership levels, pricing, and member counts): operation + args per its schema (list-operations on the read half). Snapshot-first if possible (undo: rollback-operation); destructive ops need confirm:true

name: wpmcp/metabox-read
description: Read op on Meta Box (registered meta boxes and per-post custom field values): operation + its args (list-operations lists each op's schema)

name: wpmcp/metabox-write
description: Write op on Meta Box (registered meta boxes and per-post custom field values): operation + args per its schema (list-operations on the read half). Snapshot-first if possible (undo: rollback-operation); destructive ops need confirm:true

name: wpmcp/plugin-data-read
description: Read op on JetEngine and Pods fields, TranslatePress strings, Code Snippets, BuddyPress and BuddyBoss Platform community data, bbPress forums, WS Form and Everest Forms forms, WP Activity Log and Simple History logs, Pretty Links and ThirstyAffiliates links, Advanced Ads ads and placements, Popup Maker popups, OptinMonster campaigns, Events Manager events and bookings, Action Scheduler queues, Site Reviews reviews, WP Mail Logging, Check and Log Email and Email Log emails, WPGraphQL queries, WP Simple Pay forms, Paid Member Subscriptions plans, wpForo and Asgaros Forum forums, Restrict Content and Restrict Content Pro memberships, Ultimate Member roles and forms, Easy Digital Downloads stores, WP Job Manager, GeoDirectory and Directorist listings, PublishPress Planner, PublishPress Checklists and PublishPress Future, Custom Post Type UI and MB Custom Post Types post types, Better Search Replace and Search Regex search and replace, Popup Builder, Hustle and Depicter popups, GTM4WP, PixelYourSite, Meta Pixel for WordPress and Microsoft Clarity tracking IDs, Discount Rules for WooCommerce pricing rules, Smash Balloon Instagram Feed feeds, WP All Import and WP All Export jobs, FileBird media folders, Max Mega Menu settings and themes, WP Go Maps, WP Maps and WP Store Locator locations, FooGallery galleries, JetFormBuilder forms, Kadence Blocks forms, Jetpack Forms responses, Variation Swatches for WooCommerce swatches, Product Feed Pro for WooCommerce feeds and Cart Abandonment Recovery for WooCommerce carts, MetaSlider, Modula, Envira Gallery, Smart Slider 3 and NextGEN Gallery galleries and sliders: operation + its args (list-operations lists each op's schema)

name: wpmcp/plugin-data-write

name: wpmcp/create-site-part
description: Create a header, footer or 404 site part, shown where an include rule matches and no exclude rule does; not the Elementor theme-template tools

name: wpmcp/list-site-parts
description: List site parts with their conditions and status, optionally by part_type

name: wpmcp/resolve-site-part
description: Which site part wins for a context (most specific, then priority), with every candidate and why. post_id alone fills post_type and term_ids

name: wpmcp/update-site-part
description: Edit a site part; omitted fields are kept, part_type is fixed. Snapshot-first: operation_id rolls it back

name: wpmcp/set-site-part-status
description: Activate (publish) or deactivate (draft) a site part; only active parts resolve. Snapshot-first

name: wpmcp/delete-site-part
description: Trash a site part. Snapshot-first: operation_id rolls it back

name: wpmcp/gateway-provision
description: Provision or rotate the site gateway credential. Returns client_id, client_secret and refresh_token once; the previous credential dies immediately. Carries the calling user's capabilities. Requires confirm: true

name: wpmcp/gateway-status
description: Whether the site gateway credential exists, its client_id and whether OAuth is enabled. Never returns secrets

name: wpmcp/gateway-revoke
description: Revoke the site gateway credential and every token bound to it. Local, idempotent. Requires confirm: true

name: wpmcp/search-content
description: Search all site text, incl. what post_content search misses: Elementor and Bricks settings, block attributes, template parts, reusable blocks and nav menus. Each hit has a location (block path, element id or menu item id) and a snippet. Read-only; hits re-checked against read_post. Empty index: run reindex-search

name: wpmcp/reindex-search
description: Build or rebuild the search-content index. The index updates on save; use this for the first build or after bulk or out-of-band changes. Cursor-based: each call indexes up to batch_size posts and returns next_offset

name: wpmcp/list-skills
description: List installed agent skills (versioned markdown playbooks): slug, name, description, version, tags. Bodies via get-skill. Skills whose required tools are missing are hidden unless include_unavailable is set

name: wpmcp/get-skill
description: Load one skill's full instructions by slug (from list-skills), returned exactly as written. Unknown slugs return a structured error listing the installed slugs
